projects.title: Smart Study Planner Web
projects.description: Developed a full-stack study planner web application designed to help students organize assignments, manage deadlines, and improve study productivity. Built interactive dashboards and task management features that allow users to prioritize coursework and track academic progress.Designed the application using modern web technologies including React and Next.js, with dynamic user interfaces and local storage integration for personalized scheduling. Currently expanding the platform with AI-assisted study recommendations, task prioritization, note-taking features, and built-in study session tracking tools.

projects.title: WordNet Semantic Network
projects.description: Implemented a semantic word network in Java using graph-based data structures to support hyponym and synonym queries across large datasets. Designed and optimized traversal algorithms and query handlers to efficiently process word relationships and improve search accuracy.Integrated multi-word query handling and shared-hyponym resolution features to ensure consistent and scalable query results. Strengthened experience with data structures, graph algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software testing through iterative debugging and performance optimization.

projects.title: BYOW Procedural World Generator
projects.description: Developed a procedurally generated 2D game world in Java using seeded randomness to create deterministic and replayable gameplay environments. Implemented player movement, map rendering, and exploration mechanics while managing real-time world state updates and interactive gameplay systems.Designed modular world-generation and entity abstractions to support scalable architecture, maintainable code structure, and extensible gameplay features. Strengthened experience in object-oriented programming, game logic, algorithm design, and software architecture through iterative development and testing.

projects.title: PG&E LSA Safety Inspection Automation Platform
projects.description: Developed and maintained an enterprise-level Power Apps inspection platform used by 100+ employees to manage and track 1,500+ AEDs and first aid kits across Northern and Central California. Designed the system to replace paper-based inspection workflows, improve operational visibility, and strengthen regulatory compliance processes.Built automated workflows using Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, and SharePoint to streamline inspection reporting, compliance tracking, and training management. Developed real-time dashboards that flagged expired or non-compliant safety equipment, enabling faster issue resolution and improving system-wide visibility into equipment readiness.Reduced inspection processing and reporting from days of manual paperwork and follow-ups to under 10 minutes through workflow automation and centralized reporting systems. Also optimized monthly inspections by reducing per-device inspection time to under 2 minutes while supporting large-scale safety readiness and operational efficiency improvements.
